verdicts.reason: A keeps 'Sunset Sessions' as the clear dominant headline on one line, but 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' now sits below the headline, so the reading order is inverted. The subtitle and date blocks are cramped mid-banner, the RSVP button is no bigger than the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS pills so the CTA doesn't stand out, the legal text is microscopic, and the missing-asset placeholder is still visible. B is worse: the headline breaks onto two lines and loses scale, and 'Saturday 21 June' competes with it. The italic subtitle is squeezed into an illegible 7-line sliver, the eyebrow and logo are crammed into the top-left over the brown circle, and B has the same overloaded right cluster with an undifferentiated CTA, tiny legal text and the placeholder box.
